task.title: Target a specific node pool by label using node affinity
task.shortdesc: Direct workloads to a labeled node pool so capacity and isolation policies are enforced by scheduling.

step.cmd: Determine the label that identifies your node pool (for example, "nodepool=payments" or provider-specific pool labels).
Label the target nodes or ensure the managed node pool applies the label consistently across its nodes.
Add required node affinity matching the node pool label to the workload manifest.
Deploy the workload and confirm all replicas land within the intended pool using "kubectl get pods -o wide".
Scale the workload and verify new replicas continue to schedule within the same labeled pool.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
